tasks.title: Status settings persist with independent revisions and service-only access
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, migration/storage/auth/status files and corresponding Checks; Decisions 3-5, 9, 15-16; R1 status views/size bounds; R2 status rows/common rules; Counterexamples (revisions, status sizes, order, tokens). Pin merged contract 2.4.0; append migration 9 with all SIX tables: status_settings, notify_channels, service_reports, resend_commands, resend_requests and runtime_state with two generations. Request associations have no cascading FK to commands. Implement status settings/report routes, runtime-admin/status-service/notify-service, canGrant, shared throttle, dispatch and bounded route labels. Configuration writes require quoted If-Match and edit/bump/audit in one transaction under shared lock. Observational reports never bump/audit, use API receive clock and 524288-byte body cap. Validate current applied component ids and full settings limits; admin GET no-store/never 304, service GET ETag/304. T2/T3 add notify methods/routes. Document console-before-service-token rollout. Keep the migration, shared auth, status route dispatch and their regression tests together so the first step passes its full suite before channel or resend handlers exist.

acceptance.command: bun test src/runtime-store.test.ts src/server.status-settings.test.ts src/server.service-auth.test.ts src/db.migrations.test.ts src/token-scopes.test.ts src/server.allow.test.ts src/server.scopes.test.ts src/backup.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail; focused coverage may fail its global threshold. Step-8 checks/tokens/incidents/windows retained at version 9; backup includes all SIX tables. Real port-0 status GET/PUT/report cover R2 allowed/denied cases, 405 Allow, 401 missing, 403 read/cross-service/admin-on-service/service-on-admin, shared throttle and literal metric labels. Common body >1048576 bytes gives 413; malformed/missing/stale If-Match 400/428/412; invalid/unknown/duplicate component 422. Largest valid settings below 40000 bytes accepted; 65537-byte settings, radius 33, component id 65/uppercase and logo space/non-ASCII refused 422. Largest serialized service settings <=65656 bytes. Report 524288 bytes accepted 204; 524289 gives 413 with stored report unchanged. status-settings.replace audits no values; reports audit 0 rows and 100 reports leave ETag equal. Check/status revisions stay independent. Admin GET always 200 no-store despite matching If-None-Match; service matching ETag 304. Never before report; fresh at 180000 ms, stale at 180001 ms.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full suite pass with at least 80% line coverage.

tasks.title: Notify channel edits, reports and failed views honor precedence and aggregate limits
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, notify channel/report/failed-view behavior and matching Checks; Decisions 3-5, 12, 15-16; R1 notify views/serialized bounds; R2 channel, report and failed rows; Counterexamples (whole channel, collisions, definition/aggregate/report/admin-view sizes, stale reports, revisions). Extend T1 with channel CRUD, independent notify generation, service ETag reads and observational reports/failed view. Shadowed ids come from last report even stale; no report means shadowed=[]/never. Create collision uses reported fileChannels ids; beyond-200 file ids may be created then shadowed by notify. Enforce 16384 bytes per definition, 100 records and 262144 total JSON UTF-8 bytes with candidate replacing its old version atomically. Never resolve secrets. Each DB record occurs once in channels or shadowed; file views occur only in service.report, failed view carries only failed state/list/totals. Cap report bodies at 524288 before replacement. Keep status/check revisions and no-store admin/304 service semantics. Accept the current R1 failed-event enum and required isManual in reports and failed views, without remapping or resolving service data.

acceptance.command: bun test src/runtime-store.test.ts src/server.notify-channels.test.ts src/server.service-auth.test.ts src/server.allow.test.ts src/server.scopes.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail; focused coverage may fail its global threshold. Real HTTP: create 201+location, replace 200, delete 204, body/path mismatch 400, duplicate/file collision and shadowed PUT 409, unknown/file-only PUT 404, shadowed DELETE 204. Bad refs/literal url/DB file 422. 16384-byte definition accepted, 16385 and four 200x200 lists 422. Sixteen 16384-byte definitions total 262144 accepted; 262145 total and 101st channel 422; replacement substitutes old bytes, total 262144 gives 200. Missing/stale/malformed If-Match 428/412/400. Channel/status/check saves do not stale one another. 100 reports change neither notify ETag nor audit; admin matching-ETag GET still 200 no-store with updated service, service GET 304. Fresh/stale at 180000/180001 ms, never with shadowed=[]; stale shadowedIds retained, overflow file collision behavior covered. Report 524288 bytes accepted 204; 524289 gives 413 and retains stored report. Measured service channel answer <=274344 bytes; admin with 262144 channel bytes and 524288 report bytes <=798932 bytes, file views only in service.report and every DB record once. Failed view contains only state/receive time/failed/totals. Sentinel PULSE_NOTIFY_SECRET_SENTINEL occurs 0 times in audit/logs. Every delivered R2 row covers auth, methods, sizes and labels. Report/failed-view round trips preserve event:'update', isManual:true and event:'unknown', isManual:false; invalid event:'warning' and missing isManual give 422.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full suite pass with at least 80% line coverage.

tasks.title: Resend commands recover idempotently and expire without changing configuration revisions
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, resend/retention behavior and matching Checks; Decision 14 complete ordered create/claim/result state machine; Decisions 3, 15-16; R2 resend rows; Counterexamples (Resend and stale reports); Acceptance evidence 4 and 6. In shared-lock transactions persist EVERY requestId answered 200/202 in resend_requests, including open-command reuse, with delivery conflict check and no cascading deletion. Lookup association before report/capacity; deleted-command association returns specified 409. Create requires fresh report/failed item; 10000 request rows yields 503 even on reuse, no eviction; 1000 commands evicts exactly ONE oldest finished (updatedAt then id), or 503 when all open. Only new 202 audits; no resend operation bumps generation. Claim <=20 oldest, requeue claimed at >=60000 ms, never admitted. Keep all Decision 14 result replay/late/repeat pairs together. Retention deletes commands in any state and request rows by their OWN createdAt strictly older than 604800000 ms.

acceptance.command: bun test src/server.resend.test.ts src/runtime-store.test.ts src/server.service-auth.test.ts src/server.allow.test.ts src/server.scopes.test.ts src/retention.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail; focused coverage may fail its global threshold. Same requestId: 202 then 200, 1 command/1 audit; another delivery with id 409. Each queued/claimed/admitted reuse stores both ids. LOST-200 sequence: A creates C, B reuses C but loses answer, C fails and report lists failed again, B retry gives 200 C/failed, command count 1, 0 new claims. Association whose command was deleted returns 409 'the resend request was already handled; reload the failed list', 0 new commands. New requests: stale 180001 ms 503, fresh 180000 ms allowed, nonfailed 409. 10000 request rows gives 503 'too many resend requests'/retry-after 60 including reuse; existing association still repeats. 1000 all-open gives 503 'too many open resend commands'/retry-after 60, 0 stored changes; 3 finished at updatedAt 10/20/30 evicts only 10, new 202 leaves 1000 rows, id breaks timestamp ties. Claim <=20 oldest, requeue 60000 not 59999 ms, admitted never requeued. Every Decision 14 result pair has literal 204/409: same state/requeued admission or final/final after lost admission/late admitted after final accepted; contradictory outcomes 409, unknown 404, queued/claimed body 422. 100 claims+reports leave notify ETag equal; 200 reuse and service writes audit 0. Commands in any state and associations kept at age 604800000, deleted at 604800001 independently. Remaining R2 routes cover allowed/denied/method/body/labels.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full suite pass with at least 80% line coverage.

tasks.title: Benchmarks freeze and verify refs and count runtime configuration traffic
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, all bench Files and Behavior, bench self-tests, whole-section Checks and Completion evidence; Performance impact Controlled refs and procedures 2-3; Counterexamples (Bench refs, Traffic counts); Security impact; Acceptance evidence 2, 6-7. Extend the existing harness independently after T1-T3: repeatable --b-ref <non-api repo>=<ref> overrides B only after --others-ref; unknown/api/duplicate repo or missing --others-ref exits 2. Resolve every ref on both sides to a full SHA ONCE before round 1 (fetch then FETCH_HEAD^{commit}); all rounds checkout that SHA and compare git rev-parse HEAD, never re-resolve a moving ref. For controlled --others-ref comparisons, every non-api repository without an override must match A/B. Log ref <repo> a=<sha> b=<sha>, mismatch exits 2 'ref mismatch: <repo> <side>'. Preserve existing no-option tag/baseline-vs-main selection while freezing and verifying its checkouts too. Add --simulate-services, --service-tokens and repeatable --expect-report status|notify; simulation+real-token mode conflicts with exit 2. Add >=32-character admin fixture/token file and read-only service-token mount with empty token defaults. Before peers start, fixture creates both tokens, one status document (name,showLatency:false) and five urlEnv:PULSE_NOTIFY_SECRET_BENCH/checks:[c0] webhooks. Simulation B requires 201 for both tokens; only A's 400 with error prefix 'scopes' may disable A/log 'service traffic: not available on a'; every other failure on either side exits 2. Real-token mode requires 201 on BOTH sides and writes mode-0644 token files/vars. With injected fetch/timers, simulate the exact procedure-2 schedule: 4 settings reads and 4 channel reads at 0/15000/30000/45000 ms; 12 claims at 0..55000 by 5000; 2 status reports and 2 notify reports at start and after last load request (24 total). Late timers must catch up; validate every answer and fail incorrect counts. expect-report requires B fresh/applied after the window, A only logs. Wire both new self-tests into package.json; default Compose config still passes. Final task supplies all required repository, bench, security, manual, migration timing and PR/shared-finding evidence; no budget change.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; all old and new self-tests pass. --others-ref main --b-ref status=x yields status A=main/B=x and probe/notify/contract/kit/config A=B=main; api/unknown/duplicate overrides and --b-ref without --others-ref exit 2. Without new options old tag/baseline/main selection is retained. Literal resolved kit A=1111111111111111111111111111111111111111/B=2222222222222222222222222222222222222222 without override gives 'ref mismatch: kit b'; HEAD=3333333333333333333333333333333333333333 for resolved 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 gives 'ref mismatch: kit a'; equal SHAs pass. A main ref moving after round 1 never changes subsequent checkout SHAs; logs name each full SHA. Real-token fixture 201 on BOTH sides writes both mode-0644 files/vars, 1 status document and 5 channels; any non-201 exits 2. Simulation A 400 with scopes prefix logs 'service traffic: not available on a'/disables only A; B 400, A 500 or A 401 exits 2, seed-write failure exits 2. Conflicting simulation/service-tokens exits 2. Fresh/applied B report passes, stale or unapplied B exits 2 '<service> report not observed on b', never A only logs. Fake 60000-ms traffic sends exactly 4 status reads, 4 channel reads, 12 claims, 2 status reports and 2 notify reports: 24 total; timers 4000 ms late preserve these counts. 500 answer, only 11 claims or only 1 notify report exits 2. No options means 0 token creates and empty token vars.
exit 0 with defaults; benchmark stack defines the API admin tokens file, service token files/mount and PULSE_NOTIFY_SECRET_BENCH.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full suite pass with at least 80% line coverage.
